question: What are the most influential papers on metagenomic sequencing? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.

### Highlights:
| # | Title | DOI | Citations |
|---|-------|-----|-----------|
| 1 | **QIIME** – High-throughput community sequencing analysis | [10.1038/nmeth.f.303](https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.f.303) | 30,923 |
| 2 | **SPAdes** – Genome assembly for metagenomics & single-cell | [10.1089/cmb.2012.0021](https://doi.org/10.1089/cmb.2012.0021) | 23,114 |
| 3 | **CheckM** – Quality assessment of metagenome-assembled genomes | [10.7287/peerj.preprints.554v1](https://doi.org/10.7287/peerj.preprints.554v1) | 10,938 |
| 4 | **Human Microbiome Project** – Structure, function & diversity | [10.1038/nature11234](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature11234) | 10,343 |
| 5 | **Human gut microbial gene catalogue** via metagenomic sequencing | [10.1038/nature08821](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature08821) | 10,031 |

These papers collectively define the field — from core **bioinformatics tools** (QIIME, SPAdes, CheckM) to **landmark biological discoveries** (the human gut gene catalogue and the Human Microbiome Project), all with tens of thousands of citations.
